findings.title: GET /books query filtering incorrect (id, title/author/isbn, synopsis, q)
findings.detail: Filters applied incorrectly: id filter works but other filters are applied cumulatively with flawed logic; 'q' parameter is treated as a field lookup instead of generic search across title, author, isbn, synopsis; multiple filters are not combined correctly (AND logic is broken). Query parameter validation works but filter parsing mishandles empty results and lacks proper case‑insensitive substring matching across multiple fields.

findings.title: GET /books ordering not guaranteed
findings.detail: Books returned are not sorted by id as required; insertion order may not reflect id order.

findings.title: Filter combination AND logic flawed
findings.detail: When id filter is applied, subsequent filters are applied on the filtered set, but the break statement when books becomes empty stops later filters, causing inconsistent behavior.

findings.title: q parameter not implemented correctly
findings.detail: q should search across title, author, isbn, synopsis; current code treats q as a field lookup, which fails.

findings.title: Minor: missing handling for empty synopsis defaults
findings.detail: Synopsis defaults to empty string; current code copies synopsis from request; fine.
